findings.description: No depends and no dependents in the DAG (no edges touch t35); the ordering 't35 lands before t13' exists only in plan.md Processing order, and t13's depends list (22 refs, all verified to exist) omits t35/t36, so a DAG-only scheduler could run the t13 final regression gate before this flake fix. By design per adoption semantics (independent test-infra issue); recorded as warning, not error, consistent with the phase_5_audit review precedent.

AC platform mismatch: acceptance says 'The full backend suite is stable on WSL' and the root-cause hypothesis is WSL /mnt/c drvfs-specific, but this host has no WSL (Windows git-bash, uv-managed CPython 3.12; plan.md Commands section states WSL is NOT available for the toolchain). Verifier must interpret the AC as full-suite stability on this host; pin the AC wording and an explicit host run command (e.g. `cd backend && uv run --frozen --python 3.12 pytest tests -q -p no:randomly`, 10 consecutive runs) at groom, and have the builder confirm the flake reproduces (or document it does not) on native Windows before fixing.

docs/issues/t36.md has no Files section (0 files counted); plan.md pins backend/tests/test_rate_limit_t23.py with 'Files section to be pinned at groom' (file verified to exist). Does not trigger granularity_too_small (that requires AC count 1 AND 0 files; t36 has 3 ACs). Groom must populate the Files section before implementation; AC count (3) and implied scope are within current limits (max_acs 6, max_files 4, warn_only true).

evidence.coverage_note: requirements.md is an unfilled template; per plan.md adoption provenance the phase_6_test_infra requirements are platform issue bodies #91/#92: #91 -> t35 (drvfs SQLite flake), #92 -> t36 (XFF rate-limiter state flake). Both are covered by local issue files (docs/issues/t35.md, t36.md), the plan.md phase_6_test_infra section, and DAG nodes tagged milestone phase_6_test_infra. No coverage gap. Granularity under current limits (max_acs 6, max_files 4): t35 = 2 ACs / 4 files (at, not over, max_files); t36 = 3 ACs / 0 files (see finding). No duplicate or contradictory ACs between t35 and t36 (different flake, different test files, complementary full-suite-stability goals). No cycles; all depends refs exist.
